historical_notes: CCW47_RUN_MANIFEST.json describes the experiment at its original run time, when the raw ledger was local-only; it is preserved unmodified for provenance.
The archived Python scripts reference historical research paths; do not mistake them for production bot code or invoke the paid replay unintentionally.
